d: Strange calls echo through the forests, unexplained sounds emerge from the wilderness and mysterious footprints leave behind more questions than answers. In Expedition Bigfoot, the team investigates Sasquatch sightings, follows possible Bigfoot footprints and examines clues that could reveal the truth behind one of the world's greatest cryptid mysteries. From Bigfoot tracking in the forests of Central Oregon to analysing thermal footage and possible Bigfoot evidence, every lead brings them closer to the elusive creature.
